title: Senior Software Engineer, Connectivity, C++
description:
Ever imagined saying, “I helped launch the future of transportation”?

We’re rewriting the rules of urban mobility. At Vay, customers tap a button and a car arrives - with no one inside - powered by our world-first Remote Driving technology on real public streets.

We’re live in Las Vegas and scaling fast, powered by a strategic investment of up to $410 million from Grab. Our mission is simple: replace private car ownership with a faster, cleaner, door-to-door mobility model. If you want to build something real, visible, and genuinely transformative, you’ll feel right at home here.

Curious to experience Vay yourself? Use the code VAYCANDIDATE for $10 off your first trip in Las Vegas! Download the "Vay" app from the Apple or Google Play store & off you go! 

What’s happening at Vay

  • First to roll out vehicles in both Europe and the USA on public roads without a human being inside & currently the 2nd largest commercial, driverless car fleet in the Western World.
  • We've partnered with Kodiak to bring remote-driving technology to autonomous trucks in the US, showcasing our ability to integrate our system into heavy-duty commercial vehicles and expand the applications of our tech across the US.
  • We’ve completed 10’s of thousands of trips so far and are busy multiplying our Las Vegas fleet just to meet demand!
  • ...And soon we’ll be expanding across the US & Europe 🚀

Why this role is exciting

title: Customer & Development Operations
description:
You'll stay close to our customer base, spot which projects are moving toward deployment, and make sure Furo is there when they do: turning our planning platform into a gateway for the next stage of our product. You'll work directly with the founders and help build a new function from the ground up.
 You'll Have Fun If You Are Founder at Heart
 You get energy from building something that doesn't exist yet — no templates, no playbook
 You thrive wearing multiple hats across sales, customer success, product, and business development
 Commercially Sharp
 You genuinely love talking to customers and are curious about their world
 People want to say yes to you — whether you're building trust or closing the next step
 Data-Driven and Structured
 You're as comfortable in data (e.g., Supabase or Hubspot) as you are on a customer call
 You don't just track things, you build systems: scalable processes, automated workflows, dashboards that tell you what to do next
 You believe that the best commercial instinct is backed by data
 You Won't Have Fun If You Are scared of hardware: You’ll build a solid understanding of the energy system on site and stay on top of our integration landscape to get our battery projects running
 Can't spend half your day talking to customers: this role lives and dies on relationships
 Feel uncomfortable digging into databases, user stats, or platform analytics
 Expect top-down instructions: we trust you to figure it out
 Prefer a typical 9–5: we move fast and take full ownership
 Don't enjoy being close to customers and partners — we visit sites across Germany
 Qualifications Fast-paced environment in your past: top-tier consulting, a hypergrowth startup, or a commercial role in energy or infrastructure
 Experience in operations-focused roles and managing a large customer portfolio with structured processes
 C1 German or higher — most of our customers are German-speaking

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (all genders)
description:
Als VC-backed Foodtech-Startup schaffen wir den Spagat zwischen gesunder Ernährung, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. Mit unseren Foodjis bringen wir ultrafrische, leckere Gerichte genau dorthin, wo du die meiste Zeit verbringst – denn wir haben uns zum Ziel gesetzt, über 10 Millionen Arbeitnehmern endlich Zugang zu gesunder Ernährung zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig Foodwaste zu reduzieren.
 Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis
 Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Du machst den konkreten Nutzen und Mehrwert von Foodji sichtbar und schaffst damit die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften.
 Deine Mission bei Foodji:
 (Enterprise-) Kund:innen begleitest du von der Testphase über den Vertragsabschluss durch die gesamte Customer Lifetime.
 Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen.
 Stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Entscheider:innen und dezentralen Stakeholdern baust du gezielt auf und entwickelst sie weiter.
 Verantwortung für die Gesundheit und Weiterentwicklung deines Enterprise-Kundenportfolios – von der KPI-basierten Analyse der Account Health bis zur Ableitung gezielter Maßnahmen.
 Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten.
 Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs.
 DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg.
